analysis:
The PR changes only docs/developer/test.md, with no executable, protocol, or configuration changes. The visible diff edits: (1) line 5 drops the 'retained-console' test descriptor; (2) around head lines 958-961 it rewrites the fixture paragraph so darkbloom-platform now owns byte-identical copies of paged_footprint_wire.json and process_memory_wire.json, replacing the reference to coordinator/tests/protocol/testdata paths; (3) around head lines 1070-1071 it removes 'console packaging' from the docs-impact mappings. The patch excerpt is truncated (patch_excerpt_complete=false) and the base changed ranges include 1084-1097, but only 1070-1071 is mapped on head, so a small deletion near the end of the file is not visible to me. The base units I received end at line 939, so the changed regions at 958+ and 1071+ are visible only through the patch excerpt.

Security relevance: the documented test guidance for cache, SSD, add-on hold, and App Attest (T-041, T-053, T-059, T-060, TB-011, TB-012) is unchanged in the visible range. The new text does not weaken any mitigation, and no control, threat assumption, or trust boundary is altered. One open point is a documentation drift risk: the platform-owned fixture copies must stay byte-identical to the provider's wire fixtures (paged footprint, process memory). That is a coordination contract outside the supplied evidence, so I record it as unverified rather than as a finding. The removed 1084-1097 base range could not be inspected for dropped security-relevant test requirements (for example private-plane or docs-impact checks). Overall, no regression was identified in the supplied evidence.
